description: Use this when the user wants to find verses by words or a phrase in the World English Bible, for example "where does it say 'love your enemies'" or "verses about shepherd in Psalms". Matches whole words and word beginnings of up to 8 distinct words (words under 2 letters and extras are ignored); every word must appear, otherwise verses with most of the words are returned and marked some_words. Results are WEB wording only, so a phrase from another translation may not match. Returns up to `limit` verses and the total count. It finds verses; it does not return a passage by reference.

book.description: Optional book to search within, e.g. "Psalms" or "1 John".

limit.description: Number of verses to return (1-25, default 10).

query.description: Words or a phrase to find, e.g. "love your enemies".

name: search_bible

termsSearched.description: The distinct words actually searched (at most 8, each 2+ letters).

title: Search the Bible
